verdict.rationale: Insomnia's Git Sync lets users version collections/environments/scripts directly in a Git repo, with a built-in merge view to review conflicts, and AI-generated commit messages help maintain clear commit history — together enabling versioning and review of automations like scripts, chains, and tests (insomnia-docs-22, insomnia-docs-23, insomnia-docs-35, insomnia-docs-42, insomnia-docs-44, insomnia-gh-1). Rollback is only implicitly supported via standard Git history/revert rather than a dedicated in-app rollback feature, and there is no independent/hands-on corroboration of this workflow specifically for automations (pre-request scripts, chains, tests). Missing for 10: explicit documented rollback/revert UI or workflow, and independent evidence confirming the Git Sync review/rollback flow works well in practice for automation artifacts.
